name: Brackwell Pumpkin Patch
summary: Defias brigands hold Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in southeastern Elwynn Forest. The farm belonged to the Brackwell family, but now conspirators meet in its cottage and fields, where stolen mine gold arrives.

sections.title: A Bandit Haven
sections.body: Southeast of the Stonefield homestead, Brackwell's fields lie untended. The family vanished as crime spread through the area, driven away or worse. The Defias Brotherhood now occupies the sturdy cottage and overgrown fields. Beyond the reach of Goldshire's patrols, brigands regroup here. Morgan the Collector and other prominent conspirators use the isolated farm to receive illicit gold from the forest's mines.

sections.title: Pigs and Dark Magic
sections.body: A giant sow named Princess still roams among the pumpkin vines. The Brackwells left her behind, and she terrorizes the neighboring fields. The farmhouse attic and outbuildings shelter other dangerous dealings. Erlan Drudgemoor, a bandit, seduced Surena Caledon, a rogue warlock apprentice who fled her master in Stormwind with a stolen bloodstone artifact. Her presence has drawn dark practitioners to the hideout.

faq.q: What happened to the Brackwell family?
faq.answer: No one knows the Brackwell family's exact fate. As the Defias Brotherhood spread across southeastern Elwynn Forest, the family either fled or was killed. Their pumpkin fields and farmhouse fell to the bandits.

faq.q: Why is the Defias Brotherhood using this farm?
aliases: what are bandits doing at the pumpkin patch
faq.answer: The farm gives the Defias an isolated base near the forest's borders. They store plundered goods and arrange smuggling there, including stolen mine gold brought by couriers such as Morgan the Collector. This keeps their dealings away from the Stormwind Guard.

aliases: why is there a huge boar here
faq.answer: Princess is an enormous, prize-winning sow raised by the Brackwells. Left behind when the farm fell, she grew larger by repeatedly breaking into nearby Stonefield Farm to eat its prized crops.

faq.q: Why do warlocks come to the pumpkin patch?
faq.answer: Surena Caledon, apprentice to Stormwind warlock trainer Gakin the Darkbinder, stole a powerful bloodstone choker and fled to the farm with her lover, Defias bandit Erlan Drudgemoor. Gakin sends novice warlocks to kill her and recover the relic.

angles.text: Surena Caledon, a fugitive apprentice, hides in the farm's shack. Her stolen bloodstone choker is needed to bind a voidwalker.
The overrun patch is one of the Defias Brotherhood's easternmost bases in Elwynn. It threatens nearby farms and trade routes.
